document.title:
Allergy Relief
Cetirizine Hydrochloride Tablets USP, 5 mg and 10 mg

text.paragraph: Cetirizine HCl USP 5 mg
Cetirizine HCl USP 10 mg
Cetirizine HCl USP 10 mg
Antihistamine
temporarily relieves these symptoms due to hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies:

list.item: itching of the nose or throat

text.paragraph: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to this product or any of its ingredients or to an antihistamine containing hydroxyzine.
Ask a doctor before use if you have liver or kidney disease. Your doctor should determine if you need a different dose.
Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking tranquilizers or sedatives.

list.item: alcohol, sedatives, and tranquilizers may increase drowsiness
be careful when driving a motor vehicle or operating machinery
in rare cases, you may experience itching after stopping cetirizine. Consult your healthcare provider if this happens.

text.paragraph: Stop use and ask a doctor if an allergic reaction to this product occurs. Seek medical help right away.

list.item: if pregnant: ask a health professional before use.

code.displayName: OTC - KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN SECTION

section.title: Keep out of reach of children.

text.paragraph: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. (1-800-222-1222)

td.content: adults and children 6 years and over

tr.td: 1 tablet (5 mg) or 2 tablets (10 mg) once daily depending upon severity of symptoms; do not take more than 2 tablets (10 mg) in 24 hours
1 tablet (5 mg) once daily; do not take more than 1 tablet (5 mg) in 24 hours.

td.content: consumers with liver or kidney disease
adults and children 6 years and over

tr.td: one 10 mg tablet once daily; do not take more than one 10 mg tablet in 24 hours. A 5 mg product may be appropriate for less severe symptoms.
